framings.label: Breaking news incident reporting
framings.description: Headlines focus on the unfolding event, giving casualty counts, location in the market square, and police statements, with figures that shift between five, six and nine dead.

framings.label: Far-right ideology as motive
framings.description: Articles foreground officials' statements that the gunman was fascinated by far-right or ultranationalist ideas, treating ideology as the key explanatory detail.

framings.label: Terror attack and official response
framings.description: Posts quote police and government figures describing the shooting as an act of terror and report on the investigation, including bodies found at the suspect's home.

framings.label: National mourning and shock
framings.description: Coverage emphasizes grief, communal and church reaction, and a country in shock over an attack in a historic public space.

framings.label: Eyewitness footage and personal stories
framings.description: Items highlight video of gunshots and people taking cover, plus individual survivor accounts, to convey the experience on the ground.
